methods.primary: One-sided mean test with Bartlett/Newey-West HAC standard error at 7 daily lags; asymptotic normal reference and 95% two-sided interval
methods.robustness: HAC at 3 daily lags; centered circular block bootstrap with 3- and 7-day blocks, 20,000 resamples
methods.descriptive_only: Ordinary one-sample t-test retained for comparison; its independence assumption is not established

trial_definition: UTC daily changes in total marked equity from one continuous run; inventory carries across days and months
hypothesis: H0: mean daily marked equity change <= 0; H1: mean > 0
interpretation: Hypothesis tested on previously inspected history; dependent daily USD PnL, not fixed-capital returns or proof of live profitability
sample_note: Hypothesis tested on previously inspected history. Carried inventory can induce daily dependence; these are in-sample diagnostics, with 7-lag HAC selected before inspecting the new results.
limitations: Queue, impact, depth, borrowing costs, margin and liquidation omitted. Position limited to one signed trade.
Spot last-trade midpoint proxy and assumed 1 bp full spread; zero latency.
Funding exits use causal premium-minute CLOSE proxies.
HAC and block bootstrap address some serial dependence but not structural change or fill-model error.
Quote gaps reach 43.1 minutes; stale books pause entries, held positions use last observed prices.

dependence_diagnostics.acf_definition: Demeaned autocovariance divided by full-sample sum of squared residuals
dependence_diagnostics.interpretation: Ljung-Box tests zero autocorrelation through each lag; failure to reject does not establish independence or stationarity.
